thesis: America's richest companies in 2026 rank differently by metric: Amazon leads by revenue, Nvidia dominates by market value, and Alphabet by profit, revealing that "richest" has no universal definition and metrics diverge dramatically.

facts.claim: <cite index="1-5">Amazon leads US companies by revenue with $715 billion in 2025, a 12% jump from prior year</cite>, ending Walmart's 13-year reign.
<cite index="4-1,4-2">Nvidia is the largest by market cap at $5.58 trillion, followed by Apple ($4.70T), Alphabet ($4.10T), Microsoft ($3.71T), and Amazon ($2.78T)</cite>.
<cite index="6-1">Alphabet is the most profitable US company with $244.119 billion net income over past 12 months, followed by Nvidia and Amazon</cite>.
<cite index="1-15">Nvidia ranks 16th by revenue but surpasses Apple to become the most valuable company with market value exceeding $4 trillion</cite>.
<cite index="9-2">High market value signals investor expectations; it does not prove highest revenue, highest profit, largest workforce or lowest risk</cite>.
<cite index="1-14">The top four profit-earning companies each eclipsed $100 billion in profits and combined for more than 20% of total Fortune 500 earnings</cite>.

verified_numbers.context: Nvidia market capitalization as largest company by market cap
Alphabet net income over past 12 months, most profitable US company
Length of Walmart's run at Fortune 500 No. 1 before Amazon's 2026 takeover

timeline.event: Walmart began its 13-year consecutive run as #1 on Fortune 500 by revenue
Fortune 500 2026 rankings announced; Amazon dethroned Walmart after 13-year reign
Nvidia's market cap peak at $5.56 trillion as of September 2026 market snapshot
Alphabet confirmed as most profitable US company with $244B+ net income
